scope: Post-hoc diagnostic of exposed E2 outputs, specified before the new stratified summaries. Not a new inference run, confirmatory preregistration, or held-out result.
question: Within reconstructed identical event/date prompt/slot strata, does the fixed EO-conditioned reader distinguish post-mask flood positive tiles from hard-negative tiles better than its separately trained blind reader?
population: E2 full test 1755 IDs verified for all six answer files. Target S1 flood pos457 + hard_neg457; pre/pre negatives and S2 are not C1 evaluation targets.
quality_audit: CPU-only current post mask_u8/valid_u8 audit before any new answer aggregation. Freeze source hashes, source label checks and valid_frac; consume quality.jsonl only after its complete status/hash checks.

subsets.quality_symmetric: Primary descriptive subset: labelled-valid fraction >=.90 for both classes, matching the existing hard-negative quality threshold. No threshold search.
subsets.all_original_targets: Secondary sensitivity summary on all original pos/hard candidates. Do not promote this to primary if the quality subset is weak.

strata: event + literal reconstructed E2 user prompt (sensor, phenomenon, ordered dates, fixed wording) + slots [pre_2,post]. All rows in strata with both source classes are retained; unsupported strata/IDs disclosed as NA. No prediction-based selection or downsampling.
weighting: Within each stratum, BA=.5*(recall+specificity); equal stratum mean within event, then equal event mean. Unequal class counts never make a constant blind answer score above .5.
metrics: Per-seed/arm/event/stratum BA, recall, FPR and support
Reader-minus-blind paired event delta for each seed
Mean the three paired seed deltas within each event, then bootstrap events (not seed-event replicas)

bootstrap.unit: event; all arms and seeds travel together

validity: Pinned input hashes and exact IDs/metadata must match
All historical parsed outputs must be yes/no; never count an invalid parse as no
Quality audit coverage must be exact; no missing inputs or post-hoc repairs
Blind outputs must be constant within every identical reconstructed prompt among all914 target rows, including quality-excluded/unsupported rows
Any blind inconsistency invalidates the complete C1 comparison; never drop the offending stratum
limits: This is post-hoc exploration on previously evaluated events. No fresh-test or confirmatory significance claim.
Historical E2 artifacts lack prompt/date/cache-byte manifests. Exact prompt equality is reconstructed from currently frozen QA, not a proof of historical prompt bytes.
Current extraction code uses per-date imagery and common synthetic timestamps. Exact historical file generation lineage remains incomplete.
Different tiles may differ in background, valid area, acquisition conditions or permanent water. Symmetric valid>=.90 does not equalize every nuisance.
Post flood source labels establish label association, not an event onset between two dates, temporal comparison, or necessity of an earlier image.
Reader and blind are separately trained checkpoints. This contrast is not a pure within-checkpoint causal visual ablation.
BA=(1+D)/2 for decision contrast D; these and blind improvement are related summaries, not independent pieces of evidence.
No new training, threshold adjustment, GPU job, raw-data relabeling, or modification of E3 settings is part of C1.
